main_body: snow-dusted birch tree trunk and lower canopy
evidence: The tree is cropped at the top (row 0) showing only the lower half of the bare branches and a straight vertical trunk (rows 16-45) drawn as a flat 6px-wide ribbon with straight dark outlines and no 3/4 canopy volume or top surface.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, full-bodied Beodeul trees with natural root flares and multi-step foliage clusters, this is an incomplete, cropped fragment of a birch tree with a rigid 6px straight column trunk bordered by hard near-black lines and very sparse, noisy branch pixels.
